particle.gemSparkle.sprite: sparkleStar 0x010010F9 (white 4-point star, additive), 2-4 standing dots, 1.3 s, born opaque, shrink 0.45->0.15
particle.gemSparkle.note: magic gem/crystal twinkle: white-hot glinting star that slowly turns and cools to blue-white as it shrinks; blooms on the glint

particle.brazierEmbers.ember.sprite: flameCore 0x01000FF4 (orange fire puff, additive, 1.1 m quad) at 0.07->0.015 scale: tiny rising sparks, 1.1 s
particle.brazierEmbers.ember.note: flame-bowl brazier embers: hot yellow-white sparks crackling as they rise, cooling to deep red before they wink out

particle.brazierEmbers.smoke.sprite: smokeDark 0x01000FBF (dark soot puff, alpha, 1.45 m quad) at 0.08->0.34, rising 0.4 m/s, 3 s, born opaque
particle.brazierEmbers.smoke.note: brazier soot plume: brown-black near the bowl, greying as it climbs, dissolving from its edges; follows day/night light

terrain.volcanoEmbers.ember.sprite: flameCore 0x01000FF4 at 0.22->0.04: volcanic vent embers rising 1.6 m/s, 2.4 s
terrain.volcanoEmbers.ember.note: lava-vent embers: bigger, hotter sparks than a brazier, strong crackle, cooling from white-gold to ember red

terrain.volcanoEmbers.smoke.sprite: smokeDark 0x01000FBF at 0.4->2.2: ash plume rising 0.7 m/s, 5 s
terrain.volcanoEmbers.smoke.note: volcanic ash plume: lava-lit warm brown at the vent, cooling to grey ash, dissolving; dark ash goes dark at night like any smoke

particle.foliagePollen.sprite: softGlowDot 0x01001062 (blue-white radial glow, additive) at 0.5->0.32, 8 s drift
particle.foliagePollen.note: daytime pollen motes under trees: the blue glow dot is desaturated and warmed to sunlit gold, gentle glints, never blooms

particle.foliageFireflies.sprite: ember 0x0100168C (purple tendril-burst texture 0x08000163, 1.7x2.4 m quad) at 0.22, swarm hover, 4.5 s
particle.foliageFireflies.note: dusk fireflies: the purple tendril sprite is greyed and tinted firefly yellow-green, glows into bloom and blinks slowly

particle.foliageLeaves.sprite: leafMote 0x010014D7 (green blob, alpha clipmap, tiled UVs, 3-vertex) falling 6 s
particle.foliageLeaves.note: canopy falling leaves: follow scene light, no pop-in, keep their authored fade before the ground (no spin: tiled-UV triangle)

particle.breathFog.sprite: softGlowDot 0x01001062 (soft radial glow, additive; was smokePuff whose texture is pure black) at 0.35->1.3, 1.6 s
particle.breathFog.note: cold-weather creature breath: the soft radial dot is greyed and tinted frosty blue-white, wisps away, dims at night; fades near the camera so first-person breath never fills the screen

terrain.sandDevils.sprite: softGlowDot 0x01001062 (was smokePuff, pure-black texture) at 0.6->1.9, swarm column, 5 s
terrain.sandDevils.note: desert dust devil: soft radial puffs greyed and tinted warm sand, lightening as they climb, swirling and dissolving; dims at night

terrain.swampFireflies.note: swamp fireflies: green marsh-lights that glow into bloom and blink slowly

terrain.swampMidges.note: swamp midge clouds: murky green-grey swirl that slowly turns and thins at its edges; follows scene light

terrain.marshGas.bubble.sprite: softGlowDot 0x01001062 (was smokePuff, pure-black texture) at 0.16->0.5, rising 0.55 m/s, 3.6 s
terrain.marshGas.bubble.note: marsh-gas bubbles: soft radial puffs greyed and tinted sickly yellow-green, rising off the water and thinning; dim at night

terrain.marshGas.wisp.sprite: glowPlume 0x010011BF (white wispy smoke texture, additive) swelling 0.35->1.5, 1.5 s
terrain.marshGas.wisp.note: will-o'-wisp marsh flare: a ghostly green glow that swells, breathes and dissolves
